campuses.title: Stockton Main Campus
campuses.text: Главный кампус 175 акров в центре Stockton — College of the Pacific, Eberhardt Business, Engineering, Pharmacy, Conservatory of Music, Health Sciences. Бакалавриат и большинство магистратур.

campuses.title: Sacramento Campus

campuses.title: San Francisco Campus
campuses.text: Arthur A. Dugoni School of Dentistry в районе SoMa — первая dental school на Западном побережье, известна 3-летней accelerated DDS-программой.

paragraphs: University of the Pacific is a private university founded in 1851 — the first university chartered in the state of California and the first independent coeducational campus on the West Coast. The institution operates across three California campuses: the main 175-acre Stockton campus, the Sacramento campus (home to McGeorge School of Law) and the San Francisco campus (home to the Arthur A. Dugoni School of Dentistry).

Pacific offers more than 80 undergraduate areas of study and over 30 graduate and professional programs across nine schools and colleges: College of the Pacific, Eberhardt School of Business, School of Engineering and Computer Science, Conservatory of Music, Benerd College, School of Health Sciences, Thomas J. Long School of Pharmacy, McGeorge School of Law and Arthur A. Dugoni School of Dentistry.

Pacific is ranked #139 in National Universities by U.S. News & World Report (2025) and #85 by Wall Street Journal / Times Higher Education (2026). The university reports that 91% of its graduates are working in their desired career within six months of completion, supported by an experiential learning model with co-op internships at over 200 industry partners.

International students join a community of around 6,944 students from over 50 countries. Pacific provides International Student Merit Scholarships automatically with admission, English language support, and dedicated international admission offices in Stockton, Sacramento and San Francisco.
paragraphsRu: University of the Pacific — частный университет, основан в 1851 году. Первый университет, получивший устав в Калифорнии, и первый independent coeducational campus на Западном побережье. Три кампуса: главный 175-акровый Stockton, Sacramento (McGeorge School of Law) и San Francisco (Arthur A. Dugoni School of Dentistry).

Pacific предлагает более 80 направлений бакалавриата и 30+ graduate / professional программ через 9 школ: College of the Pacific, Eberhardt School of Business, School of Engineering and Computer Science, Conservatory of Music, Benerd College, School of Health Sciences, Thomas J. Long School of Pharmacy, McGeorge School of Law и Arthur A. Dugoni School of Dentistry.

Pacific занимает #139 в National Universities по версии U.S. News (2025) и #85 в WSJ / Times Higher Education (2026). 91% выпускников работают по специальности в течение 6 месяцев после выпуска — благодаря experiential learning и co-op internships у 200+ индустриальных партнёров.

Международное сообщество — около 6 944 студентов из 50+ стран. Pacific автоматически рассматривает международных абитуриентов на International Student Merit Scholarships и предоставляет English language support, отдельные admission offices в Stockton, Sacramento и San Francisco.
